one_liner: Nifty 50 surges 1.66% amid mixed broader market performance.

drivers.title: Heavyweight Gains
drivers.detail: Reliance and ICICI Bank led the rally.

drivers.title: VIX Decline
drivers.detail: India VIX fell by 4.1%, reducing volatility.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net sellers in cash segment.

drivers.title: Mixed Breadth
drivers.detail: Market breadth was negative with more declines.

flows_line: FIIs net sellers with Rs 5,285.37 Cr outflow; DIIs net buyers with Rs 3,319.39 Cr inflow.
watch_next: Tomorrow, watch for speeches by BOE Gov Bailey and Fed Chairman Warsh.
lesson_seeds: Heavyweight stocks can drive index gains.
VIX decline suggests reduced market volatility.
FII flows can impact market sentiment.
